thread:
Zoe: Quick callout 1h after launch: we have a mix of small UX asks + ~10 regression signals. Need a 20m rapid to decide what we "shelve" vs what we push into the next minor. 
Evan: +1. Proposal: create a "shelve" bucket for low-value / single-customer asks that we explicitly defer for 90 days unless championed.
Priya: Love that. It reduces churn. Decision anchors: Hotpatch only for P0 (data loss/SLA) or any bug affecting >=2 paying customers. Everything else -> next minor or shelve.
Mika: Dev constraints: changes that touch runtime flags, routing, or model weights require a rollback toggle and perf smoke. If no toggle, defer.
ci-bot: Telemetry snapshot: 13 release-tagged errors; top signals: auth-timeout(63), stream-chop(27), ui-flicker(11). Report: https://redwood-internal/d/launch/1710101010
Evan: I'll run a quick users-impacted join and fold in CS tickets. Command I'll use:

```bash
sentry-cli search "tag:release AND tag:postlaunch" --fields=count,users --limit=30
zendesk-cli export --filter "regression" --since 48h
```

Zoe: Nice. Let's record a tiny risk budget: max 2 changes touching model/routing in the minor and 0 hotpatches unless P0. Also, prefer canary-first for infra changes.
Priya: I'll triage auth-timeout and stream-chop; Mika can pick up ui-flicker and the UX asks.
Mika: Quick note: several UX asks are from the same customer but are low-effort. We can batch them in a small polish sprint if not shelved.
Evan: Running traces now. ETA 90m for a heat-ranked list and customer mapping.
ci-bot: Canary status: rolled at +30m after launch; 0 failing health checks in last 45m.
Zoe: If auth-timeout PR fixes the spike and passes canary -> cut hotpatch. Otherwise plan for next minor with owner and test plan if it touches infra.
Priya: Action items:
- Evan: post heat-ranked list + customer mapping (due 90m)
- Priya: triage auth-timeout + stream-chop, add S/M/L sizes (due EOD)
- Mika: inventory UX asks, tag those to shelve or polish (due EOD)
- Zoe: run 20m sync in #product-ops in 2h to finalize shelve vs schedule
Evan: Adding labels in tracker: shelve-90d, hotpatch-candidate, next-minor, customer-pledge.
Mika: If we shelve any customer-pledge, loop in CS beforehand. No silent deferrals.
Zoe: Agreed. Also, anyone marked for next minor must include a rollback toggle or explicit mitigation.
Priya: Noted. Will add mitigation checklist to tickets we defer.
Evan: Quick update 1h: auth-timeout correlates to a 3rd-party token refresh failure affecting 2 paying customers. marking as hotpatch-candidate pending PR.
Zoe: Thanks. If PR lands and canary is green, we proceed with hotpatch. Otherwise we schedule with an expedited slot in next minor and notify customers.
Mika: I'll batch the low-effort UX asks into a single PR to reduce risk. Labeling them `polish-batch`.
Zoe: Solid. See you at the 20m sync; drop notes here if you miss it. Thanks everyone for being crisp.
